main_text.p: ut præcipiti fedulitate factiosorum[?] Tumul-tuum absterrerent Illos omnes & penitus exi-gerent, quos pessimis suis Consiliis adversari perspexerant.

Quoties enim in Re illa Episcopali an Loco suo Antiquo & Indubiis Privilegiis in Domo Parium gauderent, obtinuit eorum Causa, Majore Parte Procerum secundum Illos pronunciante? Hæc tamen adversus Illos Rogatio quinquies licet repudiata rursum Contra Fas omne & Morem, per vim & Turbam obtrusa & à Paucis admodum perlata est, cum plærique è Proceribus eâdem vi coacti necessario abessent.

Quemadmodum etiam & Lex Illa de Radice & Germine Omni Tumultuantium clamore, & Schismaticis Terroribus promota, haud tamen utique ferri poterat, dum in Vtramque Domum infrequentiâ jam suâ Rarefactam postremò vi invalefcerent.

His ergo Studiis inquis dum (prout Ratio, Justitia, Religio exigit) Conscientia prohibeor adstipulari, cæterasque eorum sententias, consensu meo Acta Parlamentaria efficere, propter hoc jam Armis impugnor, atque in eam necessitatem redigor, ut vel Me & Regnum Meum (dum me coner defendere) in Extremum Discrimen adducam, vel cæca quadam Obedientiâ Conscientiam Meam iis profternam, qui Superstitioso quodam Zelo vel credunt, vel simulant credere, se Deo & Ecclesiæ melius inservire non posse, quam si Pri-

page.notes: Running head is Greek (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ), set in Greek letters as printed. Doubtful: "factiosorum" in line 1 (the scan is faint). A small printer's mark follows "adversari" at the line end; I have not transcribed it as text. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The page ends mid-word ("Pri-") with the catchword "mitivum" at the foot. Italic passages are marked where the type is clearly italic.
